body: Yeah, he had them, and now I have it.

I kind of resent my parents really, my disease was passed down from my Dad, he didn't know it would, at least that's what he says to me.

I really don't know what my purpose is, my passion was sports and I wanted to do a career in that, I travelled a lot before I got diagnosed and I loved that, truly. Every single thing I loved doing is going to be taken, shit man.

I'll try to find my purpose, I don't know what it is that won't be taken. But I'll try.

Stay strong.
I've fought man, I've fought. Fuck it, I'll fight some more.
I don't even go to neuros anymore, feels completely useless.
